headline: Red Sox look to salvage series against Rangers in Texas tonight
morning_brew: I am still trying to wash the taste of that last game out of my mouth with an extra-large black coffee. Getting handled like that is a gut punch when every single game is supposed to matter for our wild card spot. We managed a few runs, but the offense just vanished into thin air after that quick start in the first inning. It felt like we were playing uphill from the second the Rangers answered back, and we never found the gear we needed to pull ourselves back into it.

Jake Bennett gave us some innings, but giving up three earned runs while walking and scattering hits put us in a bind from the jump. The arson squad didn't help either, with Erik Miller taking the loss in a high-leverage spot that we really needed him to lock down. It is the kind of performance that makes you want to throw your hat against the wall, especially when you know this team is capable of playing actual professional baseball.

We have a chance to even things up tonight, and I am hoping for a much cleaner effort across the board. We are still holding onto that second wild card spot with a five-game cushion, but that does not mean we can afford to keep mailing it in. I need to see some life in the lineup today because if we keep swinging like we did last night, we are gonna make this stretch run a lot more stressful than it needs to be.
